# LaunchDarkly

> LaunchDarkly is a runtime control platform for software and AI agents. Teams use it to release code behind feature flags, roll out changes progressively, run experiments, observe releases, and control AI agent behavior in production without redeploying.

Product documentation, SDK references, and tutorials have their own index at https://launchdarkly.com/docs/llms.txt. Any docs page is available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL. The REST API reference is at https://launchdarkly.com/docs/api.

## Platform

- [Platform overview](https://launchdarkly.com/how-it-works/platform/): How LaunchDarkly works as a runtime control layer for code and agents in production.
- [Platform architecture](https://launchdarkly.com/how-it-works/platform-architecture/): Flag delivery architecture, performance, security, and resilience.
- [CodeControl](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/code-control/): Guardrails, progressive rollouts, and automated rollback for AI-generated and human-written code.
- [AgentControl](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/agent-control/): Configure, monitor, and steer AI agents, prompts, and models in production.
- [Feature flags](https://launchdarkly.com/how-it-works/feature-flags/): Targeting, safe releases, and automatic recovery with feature flags.
- [Experimentation](https://launchdarkly.com/how-it-works/experimentation/): Measure the impact of releases with experiments built on feature flags.
- [Observability](https://launchdarkly.com/how-it-works/observability/): Release-aware observability for errors, sessions, logs, and traces.
- [Agent integrations](https://launchdarkly.com/how-it-works/agent-integrations/): Using LaunchDarkly from coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor.
- [What is feature management?](https://launchdarkly.com/feature-management/): Definition and benefits of feature management.
- [SDKs](https://launchdarkly.com/features/sdk/): Supported client-side, server-side, mobile, and edge SDKs.
- [Integrations](https://launchdarkly.com/integrations/): Integrations with observability, CI/CD, collaboration, and data tools.
- [Pricing](https://launchdarkly.com/pricing/): Plans and pricing for flags, experimentation, observability, and agent control.
- [Security and trust](https://launchdarkly.com/security/): Security program, compliance certifications, and privacy practices.

## Solutions

- [Release AI-built code](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/release-ai-built-code/): Controlling AI-generated code in production with guardrails and automated rollouts.
- [Control AI agents](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/control-ai-agents/): AI agent governance, monitoring, and correction in production.
- [Optimize AI performance](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/optimize-ai-performance/): Comparing models and tuning agent cost and quality.
- [AI observability](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/ai-observability-platform/): Monitoring agents and models, and fixing them without redeploying.
- [Enterprise prompt management](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/enterprise-prompt-management-tools/): Versioning, governing, and A/B testing prompts across model providers.
- [Run experiments](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/run-experiments/): Experimenting on AI and product changes in production.
- [Self-healing systems](https://launchdarkly.com/solutions/self-heal-systems/): Automatically detecting and remediating bad releases.
- [Technology migrations](https://launchdarkly.com/use-cases/migration/): Using flags to de-risk database, cloud, and service migrations.
- [EU AI Act governance](https://launchdarkly.com/eu-ai-act-governance/): Audit trails, approvals, and fast correction for AI Act readiness.
